title: Prove exact P104 BIT receipt prices with free original history
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

At each original MOVE, grant the receiver and donors free retention of their entire pre-clock original history and arbitrary deterministic local decoding. With the scalar, history and input-independent clock/contacts held fixed, no cheaper bundle of directly nested noninteractive donors can produce the same scalar. Only packet 2944 lies in the union of all cheaper histories; it requires 56 distinct charts using grade one alone. All affordable two-/three-donor alternatives fail.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Prior #7994 `8ab2c6f27810e078ad53236f7c2518aebd7821ec` fixes the first-reader model. This proof tests the complete original word, fixed pre-clock history and arbitrary cheaper direct-donor counts. #7973 `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca` supplies the complete consumer comparator.

## Validation

Cold 163-file manifest and `python3 -I -B verify.py` passed. Independently checked both historical census implementations, direct-sum minimum including all `221,815` affordable grade-one triples, both complete signed bills and operator/provenance corruptions.

## Open next questions

Changed histories, input-dependent routing, multi-hop or altered demanded payloads require separate arguments. The unchanged configuration still fails the trial BIT candidate gate.
